messages:
andrew: Draft uploaded — post-launch blog is ready for quickpass. Focus: benchmarks vs open-model baseline, predictable latency, cost-per-token, and webinar/demo CTAs. Need reviews by EOD so we can lock assets.
nina: skimmed intro — hero feels strong. suggest swapping 'low-latency' -> 'predictable latency' to match positioning. also need a 1-liner for the webinar CTA.
jake: can we standardize UTMs? dropping template: 
`?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_content=hero_cta`
nina: perfect, will use that for all CTAs.
andrew: @priya can you confirm HubSpot routing? we want demo signups -> SDR queue A; webinar registrations -> webinar nurture. also set list flags for remarketing.
priya: confirmed. i'll create two static lists: "DL-dedicated-demo" and "DL-launch-webinar" and a workflow to set `lead_source=blog_post`. will add owner assignment by domain.
legal: quick question — any vendor comparisons or named-competitor claims in the draft? need to review those lines.
andrew: we reference an "open-llm" baseline internally; we'll keep it generic and include eval methodology in appendix. not naming vendors. sharing eval notes now.
marketing-bot: Reminder: publish window scheduled for 2026-03-25 09:00 PT. :bell:
emma: demo capacity check — can we host 4x30m public demo slots on launch day + 2 enterprise hold slots? @ops?
ops: yes — infrastructure and room booking ok. recommend 4 public + 2 reserved for AE outreach.
jake: inbound routing rule proposal: if email domain in enterprise allowlist -> assign AE immediately; else if personal gmail/yahoo -> nurture drip and add to webinar nurture. also add scoring + tag by utm_campaign.
nina: also want a short testimonial snippet in the hero. @andrew can you request an exec quote?
andrew: will grab a 1-line from comms. pinging now.
priya: HubSpot steps i'll implement tonight: 1) capture utm params on form 2) add to corresponding list 3) set `source=blog_post` property 4) owner assignment by domain 5) trigger lead score workflow 6) add webinar tag if registered.
jake: small dev note for analytics: add GA event on demo CTA: `ga('send','event','Blog','Click','Demo CTA')` and track form submissions with `eventLabel: 'blog_demo_cta'`.
nina: wording question — change "try Redwood without commitment" -> "try Redwood free for 30 days"? legal?
legal: "free for 30 days" ok as long as we don't promise paid features during trial. clear T&Cs link required.
andrew: action items: andrew — get exec 1-liner + finalize hero claim; nina — finalize copy + add replay CTA; jake — implement UTM/GA mapping + event names; priya — HubSpot workflows + lists; legal — final signoff by 5pm.
emma: also recommending we gate the launch replay behind email capture so late visitors become leads. add "Watch the launch replay" block below main CTA.
nina: will add a gated replay block with short form and UTM param `utm_content=replay_block`.
jake: propose adding frontend snippet for demo button: `onclick="ga('send','event','Blog','Click','Demo CTA');window.location='/demo?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch'"`
ops: re: demo ops — please ensure we have calendar links for each slot and reserved attendees list for enterprise hold. i'll provision 2 reserved slots.
andrew: if no objections i'll lock copy at 5pm and request legal signoff. :thumbsup: 
priya: mapping note — i'll also add a webhook to push demo leads to SDR Slack channel `#sales-inbound` with domain and utm details.
marketing-bot: Quick reactions summary: :white_check_mark: 7 — proceed to lock and send to legal.
andrew: thanks all — will post final copy in #eng-comm and DM design for hero asset update.
